{"inp":{"code":"# Calculations for Auren Energia (AURE3) on 2024-03-01
price = 12.85
shares = 1_000_000_000  # assumed
net_debt = 1.307927e9
ebit = 877026000.0
lpa = 2.027858
vpa = 13.9624

market_cap = price * shares
ev = market_cap + net_debt
p_l = price / lpa
p_vp = price / vpa
ev_ebit = ev / ebit
upside = (16.0 / price - 1) * 100

print(f"price: {price:.2f}")
print(f"market_cap: R$ {market_cap/1e9:.3f} bi")
print(f"net_debt: R$ {net_debt/1e9:.3f} bi")
print(f"EV: R$ {ev/1e9:.3f} bi")
print(f"EBIT (12m): R$ {ebit/1e6:.3f} mi")
print(f"P/L: {p_l:.2f}")
print(f"P/VP: {p_vp:.2f}")
print(f"EV/EBIT: {ev_ebit:.2f}")
print(f"Upside to R$16,00: {upside:.1f}%")
"} }
